description: Validates a JSON value against a caller-supplied JSON Schema (Draft-07 subset), deterministically and offline. Use to gate an LLM's or a tool's structured output before acting on it. Returns PASS/FLAG/BLOCK with per-error JSON paths.

data.description: The JSON value to validate (any type).

schema.description: JSON Schema (Draft-07 subset) to validate against.

name: validate_schema
